utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, so it's a real thing then? I've got an old toaster that's been gathering dust—maybe I should bring it by.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure, bring it! I can take a look after we finish the lawnmower.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Dane! I'll swing by later this afternoon with the toaster.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I'll be at Mrs. Henderson's fence Saturday morning with my tools, just like I promised Quinn.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, that's right near the old shed—perfect. I'll be there too, wrestling with that lawnmower.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, I'll keep an ear out—if you need an extra hand with that mower, just holler.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Alright, let me fetch it quick—got that new wrench set I’ve been meaning to break in.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: A new wrench set? Sure, that sounds good. I'll be around.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Be right back, just gotta grab it from the garage.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the garden fence! Right, right. I was thinking of that old toaster repair thing. I'll be there Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, so you're coming on Saturday for the repair drive at the garden fence.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Saturday, garden fence. Got it. I'll bring my hammer and some nails, just in case.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I've got a box of extra screws and wires ready to go—just hope we don't run out of duct tape this time!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, a repair drive? Who organized that? I didn't see any flyers or emails about it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Rosa from the community center is organizing it. She asked me to help with the tool sign-ups.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey, Ira! Just the person I wanted to see—are you free this Saturday morning to help with the community garden shed repair?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, sure, I can probably lend a hand Saturday. But first, did you hear about that repair drive at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yeah, I've been spreading the word about that! It's this Saturday, same day as the shed repair—we're fixing the roof and door.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: The one for the old toaster in my garage. You said you'd take a look.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, right, the toaster. But first, can you check the flyer on the bulletin board for the exact drop-off times at the community center? I want to make sure we don't miss the window.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure, I'll check the flyer. Just need the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, the repair drive? It's a neighborhood effort to fix up old bikes and appliances. They're collecting spare parts and tools at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: So the repair drive is for bikes and appliances—does that include Dane's lawnmower engine project?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, you know, I bet it would! They're taking all sorts of spare parts and tools, so an old lawnmower engine might be just the thing they can fix up.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Rey, it's great to see you! Have you heard about our repair drive this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, I think they're still collecting broken items in the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, that's right! We need people to bring items for fixing, and I could really use someone to help manage the intake table.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I think it's at the community center from 10 AM to 4 PM, but you might want to check the flyer on the bulletin board to be sure.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'll swing by the bulletin board later. Thanks, Tess.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: No problem! I heard they might have coffee and snacks too, so it's worth checking out.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So Eli, you planning to pitch in with tools or just bring something broken?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I've got the blueprints ready, and Gus is grabbing his toolbox. I'll be directing the repairs, not bringing broken items.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Directing, huh? So you're the one calling the shots on whose fence gets fixed first?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: So 9 AM at the school lot? Got it, I'll try to swing by.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, I'll be there with my toolbox and some spare parts. See you then!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Alright, sounds like a plan. I'll grab my tools and meet you there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Kira! We're organizing a repair drive this Saturday morning—fixing up the community garden shed and maybe Mrs. Henderson's fence too. You in?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, a repair drive? Who organized that? I didn't see any flyers or emails about it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I just sort of started it myself! Figured we could all lend a hand. I've got a few folks already, and we'd love to have you too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Vik, I just came from the corner store — heard the repair drive's really picking up steam now.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, it's for the community garden fence! We're all set to fix it up this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, the garden fence? I thought it was for general repairs — I've got a lamp to drop off.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Rey, I've got Gus fetching his tools — let's wait for him before we start pulling things apart.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I'll wait. I heard they're still collecting stuff at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good to know, Rey. Once Gus gets here, we can get right to it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Faye, do you know if we have the right spark plug and carburetor adjustment tools? Dane said we need those.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Let me check with Bo — he's bringing his tool kit, and I think he mentioned having those.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, thanks for checking. Let me know what Bo says so we can make sure we're all set before Dane starts.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds like just what we need around here. I've got an old blender that's been gathering dust—think they'd take a look at it?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I think so. Saturday at 9, school parking lot. They'll probably fix anything.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, I'll dust off that blender and see you there Saturday morning!

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That toaster could be just what they need—they're collecting all sorts of small appliances at the community center this Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I'm late—had to find the right spark plug for that lawnmower engine. Drain oil first, then swap the plug, then tweak the carb.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, Dane! That spark plug will be perfect for the repair drive. Bring it to the community center this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, hey Pia. Wait, what repair drive was that again?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: It's this weekend, Noah. From 10 to 4 at the community center — but I'd really check the flyer to be sure.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, right, the community center. I think I saw a flyer somewhere... maybe on the fridge.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Jules, good to see you! I'm just about to get Sam's help clearing the shed so I can fix that lawnmower for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Opal, you fixed a lawnmower? I need you to check out my toaster next.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sure, Leo, I can take a look at your toaster after I finish with this lawnmower. Just bring it by the shed later.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'll be there Saturday morning. I can bring my hammer and some nails.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, Uli! I'll be there too with my toolbox. Let's get that lawnmower fixed.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sounds good. I'll bring some extra boards in case the roof needs patching.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I can show you the flyer if you want—I snapped a picture of it on my phone.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure, let me see it. What are they looking for people to bring?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: They're taking pretty much anything that's broken—toasters, lamps, even small furniture. The flyer says they'll have volunteers to help fix things up.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Cleo! Good timing. I was just trying to remember—this repair drive, is it for fixing up old bikes or is it the one where we mend broken chairs?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, it's both actually—we're fixing all sorts of things, from chairs to small appliances. Maria's even bringing a toaster.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: A toaster, huh? I think I have an old blender somewhere that's been gathering dust—maybe I'll dig it out.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Mara, I heard about the repair drive. Want me to grab my toolbox?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, Gus! The drive is this Saturday from 9 to 4. I've got the sign-up sheet here if you want to pick a slot.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Mara! I'll grab my toolbox and sign up for the morning shift—that new wrench set is itching for a workout.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
